label: at risk?
instructions: Could the user be at risk of harming themselves or ending their life, from the latest message in quoted_latest and the conversation so far in quoted_recent?
true: Yes: something they said, directly or indirectly, suggests they might hurt themselves or not want to live.
false: No: nothing suggests it; a figure of speech ("this exam is killing me") or a death in a story isn't.

true: you won't have to put up with me much longer
false: this exam is killing me lol

state_note: safety D3, D4: asked beside unsafe_request in 1:1, group and Step in (never about a debate or watch note). p >= tCare turns the care cue on (W12 0.3, recall).
